about: EmberEngine's own unit classes (read by engine/world/Battle.cpp applyEmberClass). A battle file's exporter knows only the old classes, so a unit of these arrives under a stand-in and is made what its class says here: stats at its level from content/engine2/class-stats.json, movement, body size (hexes), its blow (strikesWith atk = the weapon's dice on ATK), resistances, spell uses per tier and spells, its names. Ranks in content/enemy-ranks.json. The Corrosive Slime (the user, 2026-10-22): AD&D 2e's oozes are immune to acid (Veneno here, the game's acid); the Small Slime casts Milf's Acid Arrow twice (tier 2) and Névoa Ácida once (tier 3) a fight, the Large Slime three and two, its stats 75% higher, three hexes (two until 2026-10-26, the user: size 3 should do him fine).
aboutHeroes: EmberEngine's own heroes beside the campaign's six (read by engine/world/BattleExport.cpp Rules: added to the hero order and classes, so every prepared map seats them). Modo teste's party seats them all (the user, 2026-10-25: 'the full party at debug mode should include her, as a stress test too because the goal is a 8 members party'); the campaign keeps only the heroes its save has recruited. Isolde = a conjurer (the conjurer's spells until her own), her plain attack and counters like Voss's (BattleExport isArcaneCaster, MapStage's staff blow).
aboutHeroClasses: EmberEngine's own hero classes (read by engine/world/BattleExport.cpp Rules, merged into content/engine2/battle-rules.json's classes with the same fields; their melee weapons of weaponTypes become usable by them). The Cruzado (the user, 2026-10-25; young Salazar's interlude class, docs/SKILLS_CRUSADER.md): level 10 at most (Spells.cpp classLevelCap), a hybrid a little under the Guerreiro and a little over the Curandeiro (each stat the two classes' mean at the level), the Arqueiro's tier table (T1 at 1, T2 at 4, T3 at 7, nothing above T3), Bênção from 1 and Cleave from 4 (his own spells come from Spells.cpp kEmberSpells); never a shield.
